questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 2, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 3 will be opposite to it.

If A + B means that A is the father of B, A – B means that A is the mother of B, A × B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the son of P?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given : 

 
 

 
 
Q is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Mother

to P

 
 
 

So, according to the given symbols :​​​

 
• Option - (1) : P × P – Q → This option is invalid. So, it will not be the correct answer.
 
• Option - (2) : P + Q – R → P is the father of Q who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b7e0c2f473688f32fbd58ba991247853e3d0e0da5d6c69e462c9952c5503261.png] ​

Here, Q is the daughter of P.

 
• Option - (4) : P – Q + R → P is the mother of Q who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/278d20f10c9d543550aad7b9bbc1028f6fb525c2588ee6ee3613803926c7f2ac.png] ​

Here, **Q is the son of P.**

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.

questions.question: What day of the week will be on 1st January 2033?
questions.solution:
Given : Year - 2033

**Explanation:**

Calculating the **odd days for 31st December 2032** :

2032 can be written as → (2000 + 32) so,

2000 → **0**

And,

32 → Dividing 32 by 4 will give get quotient 8 i.e:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c9c3eb4ee55a35621926919ea162c11357bb9cfe9e46e79d0c76be631bd6036.png] 

Now, 40 ÷ 7 = Remainder = **5**

As 5 is the code for Friday , thus it is **Friday on** 31st December 2032.

And, 

1st January is one day after 31st December 2032, so it will be Saturday.

Hence, "Saturday" is the correct answer.
